research_question_and_methods.justification: The objectives and hypotheses are explicit, and the methodology is well-detailed, aligning with the study design focused on public health relevance regarding RVO and COVID-19 vaccination.
research_question_and_methods.quote: The objective of the present study is to examine the levels of SARS-CoV-2 IgG antibody titres post COVID-19 vaccine in retinal vein occlusion (RVO) patients and in healthy control group.

results_and_conclusion.justification: Results are presented but lack consistency and clarity, particularly in interpretation and conclusions, which appear overstated given the limitations.
results_and_conclusion.quote: These findings suggest elevated titers are a characteristic feature of RVO, supporting a strong association with thromboembolic events after receiving the COVID-19 vaccine.
